lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜ ਭੁਇਅੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਹਿ ਅਬ ਕਛੁ ਮਰਮੁ ਜਨਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaj bhuia(n)g prasa(n)g jaise hahi ab kachh maram janaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Like the story of the rope mistaken for a snake, the mystery has now been explained to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਟਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ਅਬ ਕਹਤੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: anik katak jaise bhool pare ab kahate kahan na aaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: Like the many bracelets, which I mistakenly thought were gold; now, I do not say what I said then. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੇ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੇਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੋੁਗਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarabe ek anekai suaamee sabh ghat bhougavai soee ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is pervading the many forms; He enjoys Himself in all hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਹਾਥ ਪੈ ਨੇਰੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas haath pai nerai sahaje hoi s hoee ||4||1||
lines.translation: Says Ravi Daas, the Lord is nearer than our own hands and feet. Whatever will be, will be. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਹਮ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਮੋਹ ਫਾਸ ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਧਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau ham baa(n)dhe moh phaas ham prem badhan tum baadhe ||
lines.translation: If I am bound by the noose of emotional attachment, then I shall bind You, Lord, with the bonds of love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੇ ਛੂਟਨ ਕੋ ਜਤਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਛੂਟੇ ਤੁਮ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: apane chhootan ko jatan karahu ham chhoote tum aaraadhe ||1||
lines.translation: Go ahead and try to escape, Lord; I have escaped by worshipping and adoring You. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਜਾਨਤ ਹਹੁ ਜੈਸੀ ਤੈਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maadhave jaanat hahu jaisee taisee ||
lines.translation: O Lord, You know my love for You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਹੁਗੇ ਐਸੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab kahaa karahuge aisee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Now, what will You do? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੀਨੁ ਪਕਰਿ ਫਾਂਕਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਓ ਰਾਂਧਿ ਕੀਓ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: meen pakar phaa(n)kio ar kaatio raa(n)dh keeo bahu baanee ||
lines.translation: A fish is caught, cut up, and cooked it in many different ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਊ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kha(n)d kha(n)d kar bhojan keeno taoo na bisario paanee ||2||
lines.translation: Bit by bit, it is eaten, but still, it does not forget the water. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨ ਬਾਪੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੀ ਕੋ ਭਾਵਨ ਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapan baapai naahee kisee ko bhaavan ko har raajaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord, our King, is father to no one, except those who love Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਪਟਲ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਭਗਤ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤਾਪਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: moh patal sabh jagat biaapio bhagat nahee sa(n)taapaa ||3||
lines.translation: The veil of emotional attachment has been cast over the entire world, but it does not bother the Lord's devotee. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਕ ਬਾਢੀ ਅਬ ਇਹ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas bhagat ik baadhee ab ih kaa siu kaheeai ||
lines.translation: Says Ravi Daas, my devotion to the One Lord is increasing; now, who can I tell this to?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਜਹੂ ਸਹੀਐ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kaaran ham tum aaraadhe so dukh ajahoo saheeai ||4||2||
lines.translation: That which brought me to worship and adore You - I am still suffering that pain. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਅਬਿਬੇਕੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dulabh janam pu(n)n phal paaio birathaa jaat abibekai ||
lines.translation: I obtained this precious human life as a reward for my past actions, but without discriminating wisdom, it is wasted in vain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਸਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਹ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raaje i(n)dr samasar grih aasan bin har bhagat kahahu kih lekhai ||1||
lines.translation: Tell me, without devotional worship of the Lord, of what use are mansions and thrones like those of King Indra? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਰਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: na beechaario raajaa raam ko ras ||
lines.translation: You have not considered the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, our King;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਰਸ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਬੀਸਰਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jih ras an ras beesar jaahee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: this sublime essence shall cause you to forget all other essences. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਨਿ ਅਜਾਨ ਭਏ ਹਮ ਬਾਵਰ ਸੋਚ ਅਸੋਚ ਦਿਵਸ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaan ajaan bhae ham baavar soch asoch divas jaahee ||
lines.translation: We do not know what we need to know, and we have become insane. We do not consider what we should consider; our days are passing away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਸਬਲ ਨਿਬਲ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: i(n)dree sabal nibal bibek budh paramaarath paraves nahee ||2||
lines.translation: Our passions are strong, and our discriminating intellect is weak; we have no access to the supreme objective. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੀਅਤ ਆਨ ਅਚਰੀਅਤ ਅਨ ਕਛੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaheeat aan achareeat an kachh samajh na parai apar maaiaa ||
lines.translation: We say one thing, and do something else; entangled in endless Maya, we do not understand anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕੋਪੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ॥੩॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas udaas daas mat parahar kop karahu jee daiaa ||3||3||
lines.translation: Says Ravi Daas, Your slave, O Lord, I am disillusioned and detached; please, spare me Your anger, and have mercy on my soul. ||3||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੁਰਤਰ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਬਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh saagar suratar chi(n)taaman kaamadhen bas jaa ke ||
lines.translation: He is the ocean of peace; the miraculous tree of life, the wish-fulfilling jewel, and the Kaamadhayna, the cow which fulfills all desires, all are in His power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਦਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: chaar padaarath asat dasaa sidh nav nidh kar tal taa ke ||1||
lines.translation: The four great blessings, the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, and the nine treasures, are all in the palm of His hand. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har har na japahi rasanaa ||
lines.translation: You do not chant with your tongue the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਚਨ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: avar sabh tiaag bachan rachanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Abandon your involvement in all other words. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਖਿਆਨ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਉਤੀਸ ਅਖਰ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanaa khiaan puraan bed bidh chautees akhar maa(n)hee ||
lines.translation: The various Shaastras, Puranaas, and the Vedas of Brahma, are made up of thirty-four letters.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਆਸ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਕਹਿਓ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: biaas bichaar kahio paramaarath raam naam sar naahee ||2||
lines.translation: After deep contemplation, Vyaas spoke of the supreme objective; there is nothing equal to the Lord's Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਫੁਨਿ ਬਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj samaadh upaadh rahat phun badai bhaag liv laagee ||
lines.translation: Very fortunate are those who are absorbed in celestial bliss, and released from their entanglements; they are lovingly attached to the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਰਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਭੈ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kahi ravidaas pragaas ridai dhar janam maran bhai bhaagee ||3||4||
lines.translation: Says Ravi Daas, enshrine the Lord's Light within your heart, and your fear of birth and death shall run away from you. ||3||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਗਿਰਿਵਰ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau tum girivar tau ham moraa ||
lines.translation: If You are the mountain, Lord, then I am the peacock.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਚੰਦ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਚਕੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jau tum cha(n)d tau ham bhae hai chakoraa ||1||
lines.translation: If You are the moon, then I am the partridge in love with it. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਤੁਮ ਨ ਤੋਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਤੋਰਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: maadhave tum na torahu tau ham nahee torahi ||
lines.translation: O Lord, if You will not break with me, then I will not break with You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਤੋਰਿ ਕਵਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tum siu tor kavan siu jorahi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: For, if I were to break with You, with whom would I then join? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਦੀਵਰਾ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਬਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jau tum deevaraa tau ham baatee ||
lines.translation: If You are the lamp, then I am the wick.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਤੀਰਥ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jau tum teerath tau ham jaatee ||2||
lines.translation: If You are the sacred place of pilgrimage, then I am the pilgrim. ||2||
